fetch.name: FETCH
fetch.description: Source: load a public https URL (JSON or CSV).

rows.name: ROWS
rows.description: Source: inline data — a list of records, or a list of lists with `columns`.

from.name: FROM
from.description: Source: data produced elsewhere in the program, e.g. a source bound with `let`.

parse.name: PARSE
parse.description: How to read a fetched body: JSON or CSV. Defaults to the content type, then a sniff.

at.name: AT
at.description: Where the data is inside the fetched JSON, as a dot-path.

columns.name: COLUMNS
columns.description: Names for rows written as lists.

connection-id.name: CONNECTION_ID
connection-id.description: Reserved for authenticated sources; not available yet.

where.name: WHERE
where.description: Keep the records that match: `[field OP value]`, or a function of the record, e.g. `where ["age" ABOVE 30]`.

pick.name: PICK
pick.description: Keep only these fields, in this order.

derive.name: DERIVE
derive.description: Add or replace fields computed from each record: `{field: <row: …>}`.

fill.name: FILL
fill.description: Replace missing or null values: `{field: value}`.

group-by.name: GROUP_BY
group-by.description: Group the records by these fields, for the summarize to its left.

summarize.name: SUMMARIZE
summarize.description: One record per group (or one for all): `{name: COUNT}` or `{name: [SUM "field"]}`.

sort-by.name: SORT_BY
sort-by.description: Sort by fields, each optionally followed by ASC or DESC.

distinct.name: DISTINCT
distinct.description: Drop duplicate records, compared on these fields, or on whole records with `[]`.

unnest.name: UNNEST
unnest.description: One record per element of a list field; record elements merge in as field.key.

spread.name: SPREAD
spread.description: Turn a record field into field.key fields.

join.name: JOIN
join.description: Join another data set: `{with: <source> on: "id" kind: LEFT prefix: "c-"}`.

format.name: FORMAT
format.description: Format numbers or dates as text with an Excel pattern: `{revenue: "$#,##0.00" time: "yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm"}`.

JSON.name: TAG
JSON.description: Read the fetched body as JSON.

CSV.name: TAG
CSV.description: Read the fetched body as CSV, with a header row.

NOT-EQUALS.name: TAG
NOT-EQUALS.description: The field does not equal the value (missing fields count as not equal).

ABOVE.name: TAG
ABOVE.description: The field is greater than the value.

AT-LEAST.name: TAG
AT-LEAST.description: The field is greater than or equal to the value.

BELOW.name: TAG
BELOW.description: The field is less than the value.

AT-MOST.name: TAG
AT-MOST.description: The field is less than or equal to the value.

IN.name: TAG
IN.description: The field is one of a list of values.

NOT-IN.name: TAG
NOT-IN.description: The field is none of a list of values.

CONTAINS.name: TAG
CONTAINS.description: The field's text contains the value.

STARTS-WITH.name: TAG
STARTS-WITH.description: The field's text starts with the value.

ENDS-WITH.name: TAG
ENDS-WITH.description: The field's text ends with the value.

MISSING.name: TAG
MISSING.description: The field is missing or null.

PRESENT.name: TAG
PRESENT.description: The field is present and not null.

COUNT.name: TAG
COUNT.description: How many records (or, with a field, how many non-null values).

MIN.name: TAG
MIN.description: The smallest value of a field.

MAX.name: TAG
MAX.description: The largest value of a field.

COUNT-DISTINCT.name: TAG
COUNT-DISTINCT.description: How many different values a field has.

LEFT.name: TAG
LEFT.description: Keep every record on the left, matched or not.

INNER.name: TAG
INNER.description: Keep only records that match on both sides.
